article.title: Myocardial transcriptome analysis of human arrhythmogenic right ventricular cardiomyopathy

implementation: Original reanalysis for ACM Methods Atlas; not original authors' code or an exact reproduction of their preprocessing/statistical tests.

inputs.role: Deposited MAS5 global-scaled linear intensities and public sample metadata
Pinned GEO annotation snapshot; drop missing/multiple gene symbols

data_redistribution: Download public source files into ignored cache. Raw/prepared expression matrices and full donor clinical covariate tables are not redistributed. Derived QC and sensitivity tables retain the original public study sample/donor labels and diagnosis/chamber labels.
processing: MAS5 global scaling target intensity 100; apply log2(x), without pseudocount, after requiring every value to be positive and finite.
primary_estimand: mean(log2(RV)-log2(LV)) in ARVC minus mean(log2(RV)-log2(LV)) in NF
bridge: B-S1: reproducible chamber-level tissue expression only; paired CMR/EAM and prospective clinical outcomes remain unavailable.
limitations: End-stage transplant tissue cannot establish early disease chronology or a treatment window.
Bulk tissue mixes cell types and cannot identify cellular spatial neighborhoods.
Pairing controls within-donor chamber comparison, not between-group confounding.
Age/sex distributions differ and NF_5 has missing covariates; complete-case adjustment is a sensitivity analysis.
No independent cohort validation; method agreement or leave-one-donor-out stability is not external validation.
A nonsignificant chamber or interaction test does not demonstrate equivalence.
